title: Bound local errors in the P104 private-macro dual
head: 6ea94fa4e547a2038deb3aa2064f6d4e4caa5bf5
body:
The P104 private-macro dual has an attained all-cut absolute-defect coefficient `2393/2` and native-only coefficient `861/2`, exceeding the original forward word's `450` and `356`. The native rank profile is unchanged, but the signed error propagation differs. PR2096 correctly scopes its constants to the forward word; this contribution prevents an unsupported transfer and supplies the separate precision implication for the exact PR2479 dual.

The finite 4,058-event word has ideal prefix coefficient `P=64`, weighted-defect coefficient `K=3025/2`, and 4,042 completed-update defect sites. Under the explicit individual-register Hilbert-norm, exact zero/discard and completed-child state-relative defect premises, `M <= 64*B/(1-(3025/2)*u)` and all-boundary error is at most `96800*u*B/(1-(3025/2)*u)`. Thus `u <= 2^(-b-17)` suffices for error at most `B*2^-b`. The sufficient 17-bit margin happens to match the forward word; it does not justify copying its coefficients or claim minimal rounding precision.

New evidence includes exact signed maps, four sign-aligned attaining executions, separate reverse adjoints agreeing on 69,479 endpoint coefficients and every peak row, nonzero rational injections at all 4,042 sites, and a private accumulator defect that survives in X0 after discard. The complete unchanged PR2479 word/native checker is retained and replayed with source pins checked before import. PR2096 is credited for the Hilbert-defect and feedback method.

Native CPython 3.12.14 normal replay and registered optimized replay pass, including four read-only/Git-free export, retained/live executable mutation and full signed-receipt mutation tests. Baseline bindings pass. Independent AI-assisted proof/source review is recorded in TASK; no human review, proof assistant, selected supplier cold replay or hosted CI is claimed.

This covers the original G/2 dual under its owned zero-accumulator contract. It does not admit its changed private lifetimes to the original pure-copy owner/storage bill, implement a rounded recursive child, remove any precision charge, cover a corrected hosted supplier, prove an all-size theorem or change kappa. The selected result and frozen predecessors are unchanged. Canonical main was fetched at round start and before commit, unchanged at `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. PR2479 is pinned at `65e58f85d98b4a6344c6221623df1d4caa519604`; PR2096 at `f22626f334a06f6e842766e4a6647419e6821d2d`.

Reproduce with `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-dual-precision`. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; full predecessor credit and concrete next questions are in the README. Advance claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2479#issuecomment-6192161310.
